scope: generated applied-playbook pseudo-chat evaluation and autonomous improvement; does not extend Ordo syntax

process_score.purpose: measure analyst-facing process burden while discouraging unnecessary internal variable proliferation

counting_contract.open_question: Each analyst-facing open/free-answer interaction costs -30 for its first requested variable plus -10 for every additional requested variable in the same interaction, regardless of semantic-group membership. Separate open interactions each incur their own -30 base. If the interaction does not enumerate requested variables, it is conservatively counted as at least one requested variable.
counting_contract.open_question_cross_group: For n semantic groups in one open interaction: n<=1 => 0; n=2 => -70; each group after the second adds -50.
counting_contract.group_collapse: For an interaction surface that collapses n>=2 semantic groups: penalty = -100*n (2=>-200, 3=>-300, 4=>-400, ...).
counting_contract.prefilled_confirmation: each analyst-facing interaction presenting model-derived/prefilled values for confirm/edit
counting_contract.prefilled_confirmation_cross_group: additional penalty for each prefilled confirmation that combines parameters/variables from more than one semantic information group
counting_contract.startup_interaction: A startup prompt/request counts as an open analyst interaction whenever analyst-authored information is required to begin execution.
counting_contract.startup_full_information: Additional -500 when the startup analyst message contains all or nearly all information needed to produce the final artifact, because the playbook has externalized its discovery/elicitation burden.
counting_contract.analyst_independent_facts: First 10 independent manually supplied facts carry no extra overload penalty; each additional fact costs -5 up to -100.
counting_contract.source_derivable_technical_facts_request: Each technical fact requested from analyst that could reasonably be derived from accepted sources/state costs -25 up to -150.
counting_contract.no_partial_information_path: -150 when execution requires near-complete upfront information and lacks a graceful progressive/partial-information path.
counting_contract.reasked_known_information: -50 per case where already-known information is asked again.
counting_contract.nonadaptive_question: -30 per question whose content does not adapt to information already collected.
counting_contract.redundant_variable: Only mechanically evidenced redundant variables are penalized: -10 per unique redundant variable, capped at -100. Allowed redundancy includes duplicate semantic alias, unconsumed variable, missing producer/consumer caused by dead design, or constructively eliminable alias/transform. Useful internal or derived variables carry no penalty merely for existing.
counting_contract.unsupported_inference: Each mechanically evidenced non-authority value used without required source/provenance support costs -100, capped at -300. Unsupported human/analyst authority or approval values are not scoreable at all.
counting_contract.interaction_penalty_stacking: Base open-interaction burden and additional-variable burden stack. For the same interaction, mechanically proven group-collapse suppresses the weaker open-question cross-group scope penalty. Reasked-known, nonadaptive, source-derivable and other independently evidenced defect families may stack only when they represent distinct harms/evidence; the same defect evidence must not be charged twice within one penalty family.

process_score.formula: max(0, 1000 - all non-duplicative configured penalties + capped mechanically qualified reusable-pattern reward contribution); values may exceed 1000 through qualified rewards, but negative raw totals are floored at 0.
optimization_intent: minimize total analyst effort, not merely interaction count
count startup analyst input as interaction burden
derive source-available technical facts instead of asking the analyst
support partial information and adaptive questioning
minimize unnecessary variables and confirmations without metric gaming
reuse validated canonical Data-Layer patterns for preexisting responsibilities before synthesizing ad-hoc subtrees
treat mechanically proven missed pattern fits as positive-score improvement opportunities
require final graph realization before reusable-pattern reward is awarded
avoid bundling many analyst-supplied variables into one open question
derive dependent parameters from fewer analyst inputs whenever the derivation is justified and mechanically/semantically valid
never avoid analyst effort by fabricating human-authority or unsupported values
do not penalize useful internal Data-Layer variables; penalize only mechanically proven redundancy
avoid double-counting the same interaction scope defect across overlapping penalty families
cap reusable-pattern score contribution so larger playbooks cannot farm score merely by having more legitimate pattern instances

qualified_reusable_pattern.requires: exact or explicitly approved partial fit + valid Data Layer pattern instance + post-canonical derived execution projection + exact final graph realization PASS
qualified_reusable_pattern.cap_semantics: Each qualified reuse remains a +50 event, but aggregate reusable-pattern contribution to process_score is capped at +200. Excess qualified reuse remains visible as architectural reuse evidence without additional score gain.

missed_pattern_opportunity.meaning: positive improvement opportunity, not a hidden penalty

process_score.family_cap_semantics: caps bound each penalty family before process-score aggregation; same defect evidence cannot be counted twice; process score is floored at 0 after penalties/rewards
process_score.floor_semantics: Executable optimization contract: compute the raw signed process total, then apply a lower floor of 0 via max(0, raw_process_score). No upper clamp is applied; qualified rewards may produce values above 1000.

result_score.eligible_documents: primary/business result documents produced for the user or downstream business process
result_score.detail_interpretation: a materially incorrect reference-required detail is nonconforming and is counted as missing_or_incomplete_detail for scoring evidence

reference_variants.rule: when multiple eligible references exist, build a relevance profile before comparative scoring; evaluate relevant dimensions per reference without literal-copy expectations
reference_variants.weight_authority: independent comparative evaluator using frozen policy; weights and reasons are persisted and optimizer cannot choose them
reference_variants.conflict_rule: REFERENCE_CONFLICT dimensions are surfaced explicitly and contribute no candidate penalty until precedence/applicability handling is recorded
reference_variants.aggregation: aggregate non-conflicting reference-relative analytical penalties by recorded relevance; mechanical penalties remain candidate-intrinsic and are applied once, not once per reference

result_score.per_document_formula: clamp(1000 - mechanical_penalties - relevance_weighted_nonconflicting_analytical_penalties, 0, 1000); every penalty requires evidence and remediation
result_score.aggregate_formula: arithmetic mean of selected per-document scores across all eligible non-technical result documents
result_score.empty_set: blocking evaluation error; a result-quality score cannot be invented when no eligible result document exists
result_score.eligibility_gate: Pseudo-live: PASS pseudo provenance + exact artifact lineage -> pseudo_result_score only. Live acceptance: PASS live/exact-live-replay provenance + exact artifact lineage -> formal_result_score. A deterministic executed path with zero model nodes requires no artificial model call.
result_score.ineligible_run: Acceptance result/score is undefined when provenance is ineligible. Development result/score remains available only when exact candidate artifact lineage is proven; no surrogate artifact may be substituted.
forbidden_surrogates: artifact not produced by exact candidate graph
result_score.hybrid_rule: 1000 - mechanical penalties - analytical penalties per selected reference variant; emit both decompositions and consolidated defects

analytical_comparative_evaluator.reference_meaning: quality/depth standard, never literal expected output
analytical_comparative_evaluator.reference_weighting: profile by artifact subtype, domain similarity, audience, maturity, delivery surface, semantic relevance; persist weights and reasons
analytical_comparative_evaluator.reference_conflicts: surface REFERENCE_CONFLICT; do not average contradiction away and do not penalize candidate without precedence policy
analytical_comparative_evaluator.fresh_discovery_instruction: ignore previous defect backlog while discovering new gaps; previous defects are supplied only after fresh discovery for regression confirmation
anti_self_grading: blind to previous revision score during fresh discovery

final_score.formula: pseudo_playbook_score = (process_score + 2*pseudo_result_score)/3 in pseudo-live mode; formal_playbook_score = (formal_process_score + 2*formal_result_score)/3 only when live acceptance provenance is eligible
final_score.range: signed raw score; development_score may exceed 1000 when verified process rewards outweigh penalties; acceptance_score is nullable
final_score.rounding: retain six decimal places; do not clamp negative values

reference_artifact_fidelity.when_explicit_reference_supplied: compile a reference coverage contract before process synthesis
reference_artifact_fidelity.materialization_rule: final artifact must bind full accepted content surface; review/approval metadata alone is insufficient
reference_artifact_fidelity.scoring: apply the hybrid mechanical + analytical reference-relative 1000-point result scoring contract; do not invent a threshold and do not reduce evaluation to deterministic checklist coverage

analyst_interaction_burden.rule: information derivable from accepted sources/state must be proposed/prefilled before analyst input, but every remaining confirmation still carries the configured process-score cost
analyst_interaction_burden.free_answer_rule: allowed only for genuinely non-derivable consequential user-owned decision; every occurrence is still scored by the process rubric

human_gate_runtime.rule: human/human_decision gates require explicit external decision action and immutable evidence
forbidden: mechanical reclassification solely for adapter convenience

optional_archives.rule: optional archive/delivery contour must not block core artifact readiness unless a deterministic membership/hash contract is valid for that lifecycle phase

development_score.process_component: signed process_score from the canonical process rubric
development_score.result_component: deterministic score of the exact artifact produced by the exact candidate run; technical documents excluded; reference selection remains deterministic max
development_score.artifact_eligibility: exact candidate lineage is mandatory; surrogate/control/manually repaired outputs are forbidden even offline
development_score.purpose: primary autonomous best-so-far, stagnation and diagnosis objective
development_score.acceptance_claim: forbidden; offline_conformance development_score is not acceptance evidence

acceptance_score.required_provenance: PASS model-response provenance from live_model_call or exact-input replayed_live_call plus exact declared artifact lineage
acceptance_score.formula: same deterministic process/result formula as development_score on the provenance-eligible live artifact
acceptance_score.on_missing_or_failed_provenance: null with explicit UNAVAILABLE_PROVENANCE_INELIGIBLE status; never zero-filled or estimated

hybrid_reference_fidelity.purpose: combine deterministic/mechanical penalties with evidence-grounded analytical penalties while emitting actionable feedback for autonomous improvement
hybrid_reference_fidelity.combined_result_rule: per-document result score = clamp(1000 - sum(mechanical penalties) - sum(analytical penalties), 0, 1000); mechanical_score and analytical_score are diagnostic decompositions, not separately weighted averages

consolidated_defects.rule: every nonzero penalty becomes a machine-readable defect; bare numeric penalties are invalid
consolidated_defects.next_cycle: feed consolidated defects and remediation targets unchanged into diagnosis/repair planning

hybrid_reference_fidelity.anti_saturation: 1000 is allowed only when both mechanical and analytical penalty sets are empty; checklist presence alone cannot prove perfect fidelity
hybrid_reference_fidelity.grader_freeze: mechanical rules, analytical rubric/reference set, and penalty calibration are frozen for all revisions in one comparison loop

tiers.T5_COMPACTNESS: non-semantic economy; never overrides higher tiers

ranking_transition: tier taxonomy is recorded now; numeric development_score remains the current ranking objective until separately calibrated/promoted

pseudo_live_scoring.required_provenance: PASS pseudo-live provenance for every executed model node plus exact declared artifact lineage

formal_scoring.required_provenance: PASS LIVE_ACCEPTANCE provenance for every executed model node plus exact declared artifact lineage
